subject: maths
question: When a class of 40 students took a science test, 25 students had an average score of 80, and the remaining students had an average score of 90. What was the average score of the whole class?
solution:
**Given:**

Number of students in the class = 40

Number of students with average score of 80 = 25

Number of students with average score of 90 = 40 - 25 = 15

**Formula Used:**

Average score of the whole class = (Total score of all students) / (Total number of students)
